table.name: TLGNS_SAP_MAT_PLANT_NORM
table.description: For each material produced at a certain plant, additional material-norm information, i.e. certification data is maintained in SAP. This consists of a few lines of text, as well as a (reference to a) logo (image) which should be used when e.g. printing delivery notes. Both the additional text fields as well as the logos(!) are generally language dependent. An entry in the table is identified by the business identifier (material, plant, norm, language, [sorg])

column.name: SAP_MAT_PLANT_NORM_ID
column.description: PK. Technical ID, given by LOGON, based on a database sequence.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_material. The material to what the entry belongs. (Origin matnorm interface SAP: material_norm_data / MATNR).

column.name: PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. The production plant. (Origin SAP mat-norm interface: material_norm_data / WERKS).

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_NORM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_material_norm_bs. The code of the Norm according to SAP. (Origin SAP mat-norm interface: material_norm_data / ZNORM).

column.name: SAP_LANGUAGE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_language_bs. The language in which the texts are represented. (Origin SAP mat-norm interface: material_norm_data / SPRAS_ISO).

column.name: SORG_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sorg_bs. Nullable. If defined,this row is only used for orders belonging to the same sales organization. If null: for all sales org. (Origin SAP mat-norm interface: material_norm_data / VKORG).

column.name: SHOW_LOGO_FLAG
column.description: 1=Logo should be shown in delivery note, 0=Logo not to be shown. Display of zcode1/2, text1/2/3 is not affected by this flag, only the logo (image).

column.name: ZCODE1
column.description: A text field which can be used in the delivery note, typically below the logo. Due to the shorth length, possibly on the same line as zcode2. (Origin SAP mat-norm interface: material_norm_data / ZCODE1).

column.name: ZCODE2
column.description: A text field which can be used in the delivery note, typically below the logo. Due to the shorth length, possibly on the same line as zcode1. (Origin SAP mat-norm interface: material_norm_data / ZCODE2).

column.name: text1
column.description: A text field which can be used in the delivery note, typically below the logo. Example values from SAP: 'CEM III/A 32,5 N - LH CE LA BENOR Vrac' (for FR), or 'CEM III/A 32,5 N - LH CE LA BENOR Bulk' (for NL). (Origin SAP mat-norm interface: material_norm_data / TEXT1.

column.name: text2
column.description: A text field which can be used in the delivery note, typically below the logo. Example values from SAP: 'EN 197-1, 0965-CPD-C131' (Origin SAP mat-norm interface: material_norm_data / TEXT2).

column.name: text3
column.description: A text field which can be used in the delivery note, typically below the logo. (Origin SAP mat-norm interface: material_norm_data / TEXT3).

column.name: MARKED_FOR_DELETION
column.description: Deletion code (Origin SAP mat-norm interface: material_norm_data / ACTION, if 'D', set to deleted). If ACTION is missing, or U/I, value is set to 0, i.e not deleted.

column.name: DEST_COUNTRY
column.description: Destination country of the order, identified by the shipto of material. Received via the material norms IFC. Will be used for mat norm logos printing.

column.name: DN_LOGO_IMAGE_NAME
column.description: Field to keep ID logo information.

column.name: DN_LOGO_ARCHIVDOCID
column.description: Field to keep ID of the Archive document in the Content server (could be used in the future to download images from the server).
